features.behaviour: A typed request becomes a validated plan of SET TEMPO / REHARMONIZE / EDIT STYLE ops, planned by a local Ollama model
acceptance: Request body to Ollama carries a strict JSON-schema response_format built per request (bar and section bounds from the song) and reasoning_effort 'none' (Vitest on the client module); default model qwen3:14b, overridable by LLM_MODEL

Live: for 3 library songs, 'set it to 88 BPM' and 'jazz chords in the chorus' each yield a plan whose ops apply and pass the validator within 3 attempts; first-try and attempt counts are logged (SP-2 saw 97% and 100%); any miss is reported, not hidden

Edge: an op naming bar 999 or a section that does not exist is rejected with a per-op reason, fed back to the planner on the next attempt, and after 3 attempts the job ends in 'check failed' with those reasons (Vitest with a stub planner)
The plan job holds one genQueue slot for all attempts and the unload: a repaint submitted meanwhile waits behind it and does not start between attempts (Vitest on genQueue order)
A running plan with the new queue kind 'plan' does not break the Activity drawer or the Header's /active poll (it renders a generic row or none; unit test)
features.evidence: Vitest plannerClient.test.ts (strict per-song json_schema, reasoning_effort none, model), planJob.test.ts (slot held through attempts and unload; 3 attempts -> check failed with per-op reasons), activityPlanKind.test.ts all pass. OWED: the user's SP-2 phrase listen; if 'not musical' the verb ships the op labelled EXPERIMENTAL (Q to be raised)

acceptance: While SCORE is still open for a song, the consequence line of REPAINT, ADD LAYER, an extract-to-layer and REMASTER MIX ends with 'score editing ends after this edit: SCORE will offer a new song instead' (Q-015 default A)
Edge: on a song where SCORE is hidden (ACE-Step) or already ineligible, the line is absent; after the first repaint lands, the next one does not repeat it
A Vitest on each verb's consequence builder covers present and absent

features.behaviour: The SCORE flow has a golden-path e2e in CI against fake Ollama and fake yue-server score routes
acceptance: e2e spec: open a fake-YuE2 song, SCORE, plan, review, APPLY & RENDER, new version appears; fakes live in e2e/ beside fake-acestep
Edge steps: planner offline state; a plan refused over 360 s; a cancel while planning
CI (.github/workflows/e2e.yml) runs it green on a PR; the existing golden path is unchanged and does not set LLM_API_URL

features.behaviour: TRANSPOSE: 'down a tone' shifts every note and chord and re-renders in the new key
acceptance: Every pitch is exactly +n semitones and every K: line (header, groups, inline) is rewritten; chord roots follow (selftest on the 9 library scores x 6 intervals, as SP-2's selftest.py)
Consequence line states 'follows' for the key
Edge: a shift of 12 or more, or one that leaves the 30-name key table, is refused by the schema bounds (-11..11) with a reason

features.behaviour: REPEAT and CUT a section; lyrics and section tags follow the score
acceptance: REPEAT copies the section literally (no repeat signs), un-ties the seam (library f3e3bfdc), duplicates the matching lyric block; CUT removes both; tags are rewritten from the edited score's '% section' comments, the planner never writes tags (R-018)
The review names the section to cut when a repeat would pass the duration limit ('cut the outro 0:32 to fit')
Edge: a section with no matching lyric block (2c944049's one chorus vs two [Chorus] blocks) follows the stated rule, shown in the change list, not a silent guess
Live: a repeated chorus renders with bar count equal to the score's and the copy matching the first (SP-3: 0.95-0.99)

features.behaviour: REWRITE LYRICS for one block, keeping the line count and the tags
acceptance: Addressed by block number and tag occurrence; same number of lines, no tags written by the planner; the diff of the lyrics is shown in the change list
Edge: a request naming 'the second chorus' resolves to the right block in the change list before it is applied (SP-2: qwen3 64% right block, so the row shows which block it will change)
The review says the new words need a re-render of the whole song

features.behaviour: The dock's selection (a section, a lyric line) goes with the request as 'this one'
acceptance: With a section selected in the section strip, 'make this jazzier' plans against that section's bars, and the TARGET chip shows it
Clearing the selection plans against the whole song
Edge: a selection that no longer exists after a plan changes the section count shows as stale on the change list instead of applying to the wrong bars

features.behaviour: REVISE: a follow-up request ('not so many chords') sees the pending plan
acceptance: The second plan is made against the first plan's result and replaces it; the change list shows what changed since the last plan
Edge: a revision never exceeds 3 attempts per press and each press reloads and unloads the planner (hand-off unchanged); a revision that fails keeps the previous plan available

features.behaviour: NEW SONG FROM THIS SCORE for a song that can no longer be score-edited
acceptance: On an ineligible YuE2 song, an action plans and renders the edited score as a new song, leaving the original song and all its layers untouched
The consequence line says it makes a new song
Edge: from a song whose sidecar fails the validator the action is unavailable and says why

features.behaviour: SCORE works on chord-free, instrumental and cover scores
acceptance: A chord-free score is eligible; SET TEMPO, REPEAT and TRANSPOSE render with cot 'melody'; REHARMONIZE writes chords for the whole range and the render switches to cot 'full' (D-010)
The review says which render mode will be used
Edge: an instrumental's score (Vocal notes moved to Ins) refuses REWRITE LYRICS with the reason

features.behaviour: A bar map in the review shows which bars change
acceptance: Edited bars are marked on a bar map built from the same data the planner saw; hovering a change-list row highlights its bars
Edge: on a 200-bar cover the map stays one screen high and legible (stage 5 design task)

features.behaviour: Settings shows the planner: URL, model, reachable, context
acceptance: A planner card in Settings reads LLM_API_URL, the model, 'reachable', the loaded context from /api/ps, and tells how to set OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH
Edge: unset shows 'not set up' with the setup pointer; a context below 16,384 shows a rust warning

features.behaviour: The Activity drawer lists plan and render jobs
acceptance: A plan shows as a RUNNING row (and UP NEXT with CANCEL while queued) and settles to DONE with an OPEN to the song; the render shows as a layer version job
Edge: a failed plan shows FAILED with its reason; no phantom RUNNING row remains after settle (R-012's fix must hold)

features.behaviour: Ctrl K offers 'Edit score: <request>' that opens SCORE with the text filled in
acceptance: Palette item pre-fills the SCORE request and never commits (the palette's rule)
Edge: the item is absent when the open song's SCORE is hidden or ineligible, and for the Library with no song open
